feature: Keys on a layer with several shadows move the shadow you picked
summary: On a title with several shadows, glows or borders, Animate a property now names each one's values (Shadow 3 distance), and a key moves only that shadow. Before, every shadow key moved Shadow 1.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/keys-on-a-later-shadow-walk.json.

try.do: Open the sample recording, step to 0:01, press T and type a title, then Command-Return.
In Effects, press the plus and choose Shadow, so the title has Shadow 1, 2 and 3.
In Properties, click Animate a property and pick Shadow 3 distance.
Type 2 in the Shadow 3 distance box and press Return.
Step the playhead two seconds on, then drag Shadow 3's Distance slider in the Effects list.
Scrub between 0:01 and 0:03 and watch only the third shadow move.
Take Shadow 1 out with its cross, and scrub again: the keyed shadow, now Shadow 2, keeps its keys.

evaluate: Does Shadow 3 distance in the picker read as the same shadow the Effects list calls Shadow 3?
Is a picker of 19 values on a plain title (two shadows of five values each) still quick to find things in, or does it want the shadows folded?
When you remove or drag a shadow in the Effects list, do its keys going with it match what you expect?
Does a title with one shadow still read simply Shadow distance, with no number?
rough: A typed title wears two shadows, so its picker now lists Shadow 1 and Shadow 2 values: ten shadow rows where there were five. No mock covers more than one shadow; the numbering is the Effects list's own (Shadow 1, Shadow 2).
The Animating count on a plain title went from 14 to 19 properties for the same reason.
Removing a shadow that had keys takes its keys with it, with no undo prompt beyond the usual Undo.
